OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized by removing every non-digit character and must contain
            exactly 10 digits once stripped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name

            initials:

## Summary

When an owner is created without a `registrationDate`, the server now defaults it to the current date, and `registrationDate` is returned in ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` format. A supplied date is preserved.

Changes made:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — Added an optional `registrationDate` property (`type: string, format: date`) to the `OwnerFields` schema. Because `Owner` is defined as `allOf` including `OwnerFields`, this makes the field both accepted on create and returned on read. `format: date` generates a `LocalDate`, which Jackson serializes as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

2. **`Owner.java`** (model) — Added a `registrationDate` `LocalDate` field mapped to a `registration_date DATE` column, with getter/setter.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — After mapping the request, if no registration date was supplied it defaults to `LocalDate.now()`. MapStruct handles the DTO↔entity mapping automatically by name.

4. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `postgres`, `mysql`) — Added the `registration_date DATE` column to the `owners` table. The test profile uses `hsqldb` with `ddl-auto=none`, so the schema change was required there; the others were updated for consistency.
